_doc: BUSTED — the second fail state. A repo man who stops moving with the law on him gets impounded: cruiser or officer within reach of a near-stationary Book for hold_s, then the card, then he wakes at Longhorn Impound beside the wrecker, lighter by the fine. Read by systems/arrest.gd at boot.
_tuning: hold_s under 1.5 busts a player who paused at a light with a cruiser alongside; over 2.5 reads as cops who cannot close a door. Fines scale with stars because GTA's flat bail never taught anything. cruiser_reach_m 6.5 matches police.PULLOVER_STOP 5.0 plus the braking overshoot of an easing cruiser.
